extracted.intended_audience: journalists and media covering Habitat for Humanity in Europe, the Middle East and Africa (press/media)
extracted.subtask_description: A newsroom listing and media-info page for Habitat for Humanity's Europe, Middle East and Africa region: lists press releases (headline, dateline, short summary) and gives media contact and asset information for journalists. Useful as guidance for producing or preparing to use Habitat EMEA press releases and related assets.

rubrics_metrics.name: Regional media contacts
rubrics_metrics.description: Please contact: Europe and the Middle east Katarzyna Jasik-Caínzos Communications Director, Europe and the Middle East Phone: +32 478 88 79 08 Email: [email protected] Africa Caroline Nyamamu Communications Director, Africa Phone: +254 759 067 659 Email: [email protected]
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide a named regional media contact (name, role/title, phone number and email). Offer separate contacts for different regions (e.g., Europe & Middle East; Africa) so journalists know whom to approach for local information or interviews.

rubrics_metrics.name: Availability of supporting assets
rubrics_metrics.description: Habitat offers detailed information, case studies, and housing research as well as hi-resolution photos to cover regional housing issues or specific problems in a country.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: State clearly which supporting materials are available to the media (detailed information, case studies, housing research, high-resolution photos) so journalists can request or download assets for coverage.

rubrics_metrics.name: Dateline with location and date
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include a dateline near the top of the release showing the location and exact date of the announcement. Use the format seen in examples: (City, Country – DD Month, YYYY).

rubrics_metrics.name: Headline and publication date on listing
rubrics_metrics.description: Each item shows a headline and a publication date (e.g., "Let’s Open the Door Comes to London: A Powerful Global Exhibition You Don’t Want to Miss" — May 10, 2026).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: For listing pages, include a clear, attention-getting headline and the release date. Include a short excerpt/summary and a 'Read more' link to the full release so editors can quickly scan recent items.

rubrics_metrics.name: Concise lead that states what, where, and why
rubrics_metrics.description: Short opening paragraphs summarize the transformation or event and its significance (e.g., an abandoned kindergarten transformed into 48 apartments providing homes for around 150 people).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Open with a concise lead that answers what happened, where it happened, and why it matters. Use concrete facts and figures (numbers of homes/people, dates) to convey impact immediately.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use of human stories and calls to action
rubrics_metrics.description: Examples highlight real homeowner stories and a global call to action around the housing crisis (e.g., an immersive exhibition featuring striking artistic doors, real homeowner stories and a global call to action).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Incorporate human-centered details and, where appropriate, an explicit call to action to engage audiences and spur support or participation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Label sponsored or contributed content with a disclaimer
rubrics_metrics.description: Disclaimer - An article written by ArcelorMittal Construction. All opinions in this article reflect the views of the author(s), not Habitat for Humanity International.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Clearly mark paid-for, sponsored, or third-party authored content with a visible disclaimer explaining that the opinions are those of the author and not the organization.

rubrics_metrics.name: Chronological organization and archive by year
rubrics_metrics.description: Listings include 'Latest press releases' and allow browsing by year (e.g., 2026, 2025, 2024, All years).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Organize press releases in reverse-chronological order and provide year-based archives or filters to help users find releases from specific time periods.
